actions.exact_result_status: IEDC announced AWS plans to invest $11 billion in an Indiana Enterprise Center campus over the next decade and offered performance-based state incentives; this is not a local approval.
actions.access_caveat: Official state page accessible; it does not publish a county/town vote tally or a building-by-building completion register.

actions.body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management, Office of Air Quality
actions.exact_result_status: IDEM held the announced public meeting concerning Amazon Data Services Part 70/New Source Construction Permit T141-47750-00642 after public comments on the draft permit.
actions.access_caveat: IDEM PDF is public and searchable; the meeting is an agency permitting proceeding, not a local zoning vote.

actions.body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management, Office of Air Quality
actions.exact_result_status: IDEM technical-support document records issuance of the Part 70 significant source and significant permit modifications for Amazon Data Services; it clarifies the source addresses and says construction had begun.
actions.access_caveat: Official technical-support document accessible; the initial permit PDF's signature/date fields are not rendered in the indexed copy.

actions.body: Indiana Department of Homeland Security, Fire and Building Safety Division
actions.exact_result_status: Public IDHS records show filed new-project applications for IEC-3 Buildings 1–9, IEC-3 Building D, and IEC-3 Building C at New Carlisle for Amazon Data Services; no issued/closed status or issue date was published in the indexed record.
actions.case_or_permit_number: Public permit records include p_var_id=24472, 24633, and 24987
actions.access_caveat: IDHS portal is accessible but the public result is a filing view; it is not evidence that all listed buildings are complete or occupied.
